text: 23-year-old female. The patient presents with knee pain that started yesterday and has been steadily worsening. speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Anterior Cruciate Ligament (ACL) Tear.

The history of repetitive pivoting and twisting during volleyball, combined with acute onset of worsening knee pain, is highly suggestive of an ACL injury.
